gloss: to listen; to lend an ear; to heed

definitions.gloss: to listen; to lend an ear; to heed; to pay attention to what someone says
definitions.explanation: To be willing to listen to someone's words, request, or advice. Often used in the negative to mean refusing to listen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧{耳|みみ}を{貸|か}さなかった。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{忠告|ちゅうこく}→忠告：05462_chuukoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{貸|か}さない。
examples.english: He doesn't heed other people's advice.

examples.japanese: ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{耳|みみ}を{貸|か}して⟦くれません→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧んです。
examples.english: Could you lend me your ear for a moment? I have something important to tell you.

notes:
Literally "to lend one's ear." Very commonly used in the negative ({耳|みみ}を{貸|か}さない) to describe someone who refuses to listen to advice, warnings, or requests.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {耳|みみ}を{貸|か}さない: won't listen, refuses to heed
- {耳|みみ}を{貸|か}して⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧: to be willing to listen
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{耳|みみ}を{貸|か}して: lend me your ear for a sec (casual request)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{忠告|ちゅうこく}→忠告：05462_chuukoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{貸|か}す: to heed advice
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{貸|か}す: to listen to opinions
- ⟦{訴|うった}え→訴え：14187_uttae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耳|みみ}を{貸|か}す: to listen to an appeal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける→耳を傾ける：06903_mimiwokatamukeru⟧: to incline one's ear — more formal and literary; implies careful, attentive listening
- ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たない→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to refuse to listen at all — stronger refusal than {耳|みみ}を{貸|か}さない
